summary: Lando Norris outmanoeuvered Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli through superior pit-stop strategy to secure his second consecutive victory at Zandvoort, while George Russell's sprint win proved a brief bright spot for the Silver Arrows. Lewis Hamilton suggested Ferrari's hesitation in clearing Charles Leclerc from his path during the race cost him a podium finish, highlighting the tight margins that decided positions throughout the afternoon. Despite back-to-back wins, Norris publicly questioned whether McLaren possesses the machinery needed to mount a sustained championship challenge, signaling the title fight remains wide open heading into the season's final rounds.
